title: Vontier Debuts on Newsweek’s World’s Greenest Companies List
summary: Vontier Corporation (NYSE: VNT), a leading global provider of critical technologies and solutions to connect, manage and scale the mobility ecosystem, today announced that it was named one of Newsweek’s World’s Greenest Companies for 2026 . This is the first year the company was included on the selective list, following earlier recognition on Newsweek’s lists of America’s Greenest and Most Responsible Companies. Inclusion on the global list represents a higher level of international distinction, requiring Vontier’s operations to meet 25 rigorous EU sustainability criteria. “At Vontier, we see sustainability as smart business – driving efficiency, accountability and long-term value,” said Katie Rowen, EVP and Chief Transformation and Operations Officer at Vontier. “Throughout the year, we’ve mobilized hundreds of colleagues across the globe to identify and implement practical efficiency gains, creating a ripple effect of transformative change. We’re proud of the progress we’ve made
